newsitem.title: UK: LPC-Gazprom $2.5 bln credit in syndication.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Gazprom $2.5 bln credit in syndication.

text.p: LONDON, Jan 23 (LPC) - Dresdner Bank is syndicating a $2.5 billion credit for Russia's Gazprom, bankers said.

Banks seeking to join the top co-arranger underwriting tier are asked for commitments of $400 millon to the loan, which backs the construction of a gas pipeline from Siberia's Yamal Peninsula to Germany.
The credit, which backs the construction of a gas pipeline from Siberia's Yamal Peninsula to Germany, is priced at 200 bps over LIBOR. It has an eight year tenor with a three year grace period.

Dresdner is currently approaching banks to underwrite the deal, offering co-arrangers slots at $400 million and underwriting senior lead managers slots at $200 million. The credit has been received "extremely well" by the market, according to a banker close to the deal.

Although the pipeline is not expected to be completed before 2010, the deal is not dependent on a revenue stream from the finished project. On completion, the pipeline will be able to carry 67 billion cubic metres of gas annually.
Gazprom is the world's largest gas producer, accounting for one quarter of world gas output. This year, it forecasts gas output of 580 billion cubic metres.
Dresdner Bank Group is arranging the loan and Dresdner Bank Luxembourg is the syndication and facility agent.
Gazprom is also currently seeking a $46.5 million syndicated loan via arranger London Forfaiting Asia.
